The structure of Zr2U6C12 (ZrUC3) is orthorhombic, space group Imm2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell across 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows carbon centers with 3- or 5-fold geometric coordination, one orbit adopting a trigonal bipyramidal motif with 5 carbon neighbors, and zirconium centers with 6 carbon neighbors. U centers have 14 neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between trigonal bipyramidal carbon polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between carbon and zirconium polyhedra.
